chosenApproach: Reuse canonical BUKLOD logo image, compact safe-area-aware native header, theme-aware rounded encouragement card, extracted accessible Wall quick links, and small hysteresis-based shared scroll coordinator. Integrate scroll events with existing FlashList/FlatList/ScrollView rather than replacing feed internals. Retain desktop shell and scoped section/header rules. Scope switches reset compact state.
selectionRationale: A shared header prevents design drift and excess vertical occupancy across tabs; hysteresis limits scroll rerenders on low-end devices while keeping navigation, media, sponsorship and permissions intact.
